pr_body:
This fixes a bug introduced by 03677889f0ef42cdc534bf3b31265a054b20a354.

Fixes #23288.

Could you also provide debugging logs of networkd? It can be generated with the following drop-in configs:
```
# /etc/systemd/system/systemd-networkd.service.d/override.conf
[Service]
Environment=SYSTEMD_LOG_LEVEL=debug
```
Then, please provide the result of `journalctl --no-hostname -u systemd-networkd.service -u ModemManager.service`.
I'm not using systemd-networkd (disabled, inactive) just networkmanager

Is the issue really solved when you downgrade systemd to v250?
If so, are there any relevant logs in journal, e.g. from systemd-udevd.service?
